# EU5 1.4.9 cabinet_actions: potential/allow execute in bare country scope; AI scoring uses ai_will_do only.

# 1. Imperial Translation Bureau (DIP)
oe_sci_cab_imperial_translation_bureau = {
	ability = dip
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1480
			has_advance = printing_press_advance
			oe_sci_has_any_landmark = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_institution_growth_modifier = 0.18
		embrace_institution_cost_modifier = -0.10
		diplomatic_reputation = 1.0
		cultural_influence_modifier = 0.06
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:actor = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						at_war = no
						OR = {
							oe_sci_has_any_landmark = yes
							NOT = { has_embraced_institution = institution:printing_press }
						}
					}
				}
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}
}

						is_rebel_country = no
						at_war = no
						OR = {
							has_advance = scientific_experimentation
							oe_sci_has_any_landmark = yes
						}
